Subject: Advancement casebook: finalize materials & committee slate

Hi team,

I’m circulating the final ask for Ada Ramos’s level change packet (IC4 -> IC5). We’ve collected manager write-ups and the performance evidence, but we need to lock the committee slate and confirm delivery artifacts for the packet. High level requests: 

- Laura: please attach the signed write-up + calibrated manager summary (I think we’re on v3).
- Ben: can you propose 3 reviewer candidates for the committee (preferably senior PM or Eng managers who haven’t worked Ada’s team recently)?
- Marcus: we’ll need an SLA exception form filed for the timeline compression (Ada’s promotion would be effective 11/15).

Attached are the working files I pulled together: adv-casebook-ada-ramos_v3.pdf (draft), reviewer-slates-2026Q4.xlsx, and a provisional calendar invite (committee-invite.ics). Goal: finalize by Monday EOD PT so we can send to Talent Ops and schedule the committee for 11/03 or 11/04. 

If anyone expects conflicts with that meet window, call them out and include alternative availability. I’ll own the packet cover note and the opening comments for the committee.

Thanks —
Stephanie

Director, Product Platforms
Redwood Inference

I’m attaching the signed manager summary and a short evidence packet with links to the 1:1 notes and last two case presentations. I also updated the spreadsheet with three suggested reviewers: Priya Natarajan (Eng), Logan Wright (PM), and Karthik Iyer (Group PM). I marked potential conflicts in the sheet.

- If committee is 11/03, I can present as backup; if 11/04 I’m on a customer scoping day but can join at end.
